Review Title: Incredible company, outstanding pilot, breathtaking experience!
Review Text:
My husband and I visited Alaska for my first time in early August. We knew we wanted to experience a fly over Denali National Park. After researching the various tour operators offering this service, it was a no brainer to book with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Not only were their Trip Advisor and Google reviews great, but what sold me was their policy to rebook or refund their tours. The other companies had a much more rigid refund policy. For those who have never traveled to Alaska, the weather changes daily and can be dramatic as well.

We originally booked the Mountain Explorer with a Glacier landing for the first tour time of the day. There are multiple tour times offered throughout the day, so if the visibility or weather cancels an earlier tour, it’s possible to book a later tour if there is availability. We left the rest of the day open in our planning just in case.

Unfortunately, the weather was not great on the day of our tour so they called us to tell us it was cancelled. The rest of the tour times were cancelled as well. But they offered to rebook us on the Mountain Explorer tour the next day without the glacier landing with a refund of the difference in pricing, so we rebooked it.

When we arrived for the 4pm tour time the next day, they actually booked us on the South Side Explorer with glacier landing and we still received a refund on the difference in price. We were happy because we did want to have a glacier landing and we didn’t even ask, it was automatically done!

Our pilot was Luke. He was fantastic! Super chill and greeted us wearing jeans and a t-shirt. I actually sat in the first passenger seat behind the cockpit and watched him fly the plane. It was fascinating. Each seat of the plane had a headset with volume knobs on each ear. Luke pointed out the names of the mountain formations as we soared around them. It was magical! Ruth glacier is huge and glorious in the air. Unfortunately, Denali was hiding in the clouds but the views of the other mountains was spectacular.

The glacier landing was smooth. We had plenty of time to walk on the glacier and take pictures. It was worth every penny to have had the opportunity to do so.

Since we sat in the same seats on our return, Luke made sure to fly back the opposite direction so we could see the views we missed on the way up. As we left the Denali mountain range, we could see views of the Talkeetna valley and various rivers which were breathtaking! Smooth landing back at the airport.

Talkeetna Air Taxi is the best company for a fly over to Denali Park, hands down!

Review Title: Outstanding Flight Viewing and Glacier Landing!!
Review Text:
This was an incredible experience! Last year we went to Alaska and when we were at Denali, we went on a helicopter and landed on a glacier. I couldn’t get out because of knee issues because the first step was 2-3 feet high. This year we took our grandson to Alaska (his choice) for his high school graduation gift. After reviewing several options, I chose the small airplane flight to land on a glacier this year - the “Southside Explorer with Glacier Landing” tour.
I talked to Kayla several times when I was deciding on the best Glacier Landing tour and she was very helpful and answered a lot of questions. She assured me that there were stairs and I could get off and back on the airplane at the glacier. She was absolutely right!! I was so excited to get on the glacier. The glacier we landed on this year was much different than the one the helicopter landed on last year. This was a beautiful glacier with lots of snow on it, instead of ice on the glacier we landed on last year for 10 minutes from the helicopter. This year we got to play in the snow for 20 minutes and take awesome pictures of the glacier and mountains all around us. The windows on the airplane were extra large so you could see so much and get great pictures too because there were a special plastic. Last year we just flew to the glacier and back and saw what we could. On the airplane this year, we flew through Denali Park around the mountains and glaciers on the way to the glacier landing and back. It was a beautiful scenic flight. The entire tour was about 1 hr 30 minutes.
Everyone was so helpful and nice - including Kayla and the others at the desk where you check in, the people that help you get your glacier boots, the lady that kept everyone in order while waiting for our airplane, the guy that filled up the planes, the pilots that also provide information during the flight, and everyone else that helped in any way was just super nice! They all did everything they could to make you comfortable and make it a great experience!
The other thing that said a lot about their business was their cancellation policy. They allow you to cancel at anytime, with a full refund, because they understand the “uncertainty of the issues facing us in the world today”. Our flight was cancelled for 8:30 am due to fog. The pilots made the call on whether they felt it was safe. They were able to reschedule us for 1:00 pm that afternoon. When we checked in for the 1:00 flight, they talked to the group scheduled for that time and told us that the pilots weren’t sure if we would be able to land on the glacier because of the fog and questionable flight conditions. They followed it up by telling us if we couldn’t land we would receive a partial refund. We didn’t even have to ask! It was clear that they were very thoughtful and considerate of the people that chose to fly with them. That meant a lot to me!!
I can highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi as a great choice for flight viewing Denali National Park and landing on a glacier! My husband agreed that this was much better than the helicopter tour the year before and our 18 year old grandson loved it!!

Review Text: My 4th time flying onto the mountain with TAT for a Denali climb.  Simply the best.  The most experience, the most flights, the most planes, the nicest pilots, the best facility, the best staff. I love them all. Paul, Annie et al are just wonderful to work with.  Being a private trip, and not guided, I rely upon all my contacts, especially TAT. They shuttle my gear around town, they have a bunkhouse available if needed for climbers, they stay in touch in the months leading up to climbing season. The cost is roughly the same no matter who you choose; why wouldn't you fly in a large Otter capable of flying in adverse surface conditions?

Review Text: I was able to sign up for this at the last minute AND go on a day when Denali was not shrouded in cloud cover.  I volunteered to sit in the front seat, which is the place to be on this flight.  We all loved landing on the glacier and taking in that surreal and sunny world. The ground and air service were efficient, friendly and very professional.  Our pilot narrated what we were seeing, which was helpful, since it’s not easy to know what in the world you’re looking at when things look so new to you.  We flew very close to the mountains but I was never scared.  I feel very fortunate to have had the occasion to do this. Family and friends love those videos the best of everything I did in Alaska.

Review Text: This experience is tough to put into words.  Amazing, fantastic, unbelievable, stunning, breathtaking, exciting and many others are all adjectives that can be used. While it is a bit more money to add on the glacier landing, I guarantee you will not regret it afterwards.  Our pilot, LeAnn (a third generation pilot) was extremely warm and friendly.  Her narrative as we flew was educational and very insightful.  The supporting staff of Talkeetna Air Taxi were attentive and professional. Review Text:
Talkeetna Air Taxi has over a thousand glowingly positive reviews, and they're all true. This was one of the most amazing experiences of my life. The flying was smooth, the landing was smooth, the sights were incredible. Landing and walking on that glacier was one of the best tourist experiences I have ever had in the 47 states and 38 countries I've been to.

Just note that like any domestic flight, they ask that you come 45 minutes before your departure time and masks are required in the terminal and on the plane. We could take our masks off on the glacier so long as we social distanced, which was not a problem as the glacier is massive.
